landing.intro: Rediscover the clothes you already own. Organize your wardrobe, care for your favourite pieces, and find an outfit for every day.
landing.privacy: Your photos. Your server. Your privacy.
landing.artBottom: A place for your favourite pieces.
landing.featureOneText: Photos, sizes, materials and favourite pieces. Your whole wardrobe at hand.
landing.featureTwoText: Create new combinations from your own clothes and care for them longer.
landing.featureThreeText: Private wardrobes and shared closets. You decide who gets access.
landing.footer: A more thoughtful wardrobe starts here.
